desc:
Technical MMA is a unique, physics-driven ragdoll MMA game where you have total control over your fighter's body composition.

💪 YOUR BUILD IS YOUR STYLE.
Height sets your reach. Muscle and fat set your weight, and weight drives your power, speed, and cardio. Fight in five weight classes, from lightweight to super heavyweight.

🥊 FIGHT YOUR WAY
Utilize boxing, kickboxing, and wrestling; you can slip, block, clinch, shoot for takedowns, and finish it on the ground. Real physics on every shot: rock them, drop them, or go to the judges.

🏆 MODES
• QUICK MATCH: straight into a fight
• RANKED: Season 1 is live. Climb from Amateur to Champion for exclusive gear.
• FIGHT NOW: Stand and Bang, Open Weight, Bare Knuckle, 2v2, and 3v3
• SPARRING: private fights with friends

PC, MOBILE, AND CONSOLE SUPPORT
